hooks.name: no-em-dash-guard
hooks.description: PostFileSave guard: fails the save when the em-dash byte sequence E2 80 94 appears under .kiro, scripts, bin, src, test, .github or root markdown.

action.command: em=$(printf '\xe2\x80\x94'); if grep -rlIF -- "$em" .kiro scripts bin src test .github *.md 2>/dev/null; then printf 'em-dash U+2014 found; use comma, colon, or parentheses\n' >&2; exit 1; fi
